# notes report

Report notes.

## Usage

```text
notes report [options]
```

## Options

- `--format <format>`: Select the output format, text by default. One of: text, json, jsonl.
- `--fields <fields>`: Select top-level fields of json and jsonl output, as a comma list.  (repeatable)

## Result

Kind: `value`. Views: `text` (default), `json`, `jsonl`.
